flirty.dialogue_event.mca.social.chat.vi: It's nice having familiar faces around. A few more than others, I admit.
flirty.dialogue_event.mca.social.chat.da: Rough day. Maybe ask me again when I'm feeling a little brighter.
flirty.dialogue_event.mca.social.joke.mo: Ha! I suppose there's no getting under a skeleton's skin.
flirty.dialogue_event.mca.social.joke.cr: A ladder at the market? I'd rather someone offered me a hand.
flirty.dialogue_event.mca.social.story.g: That was a close call. I'm glad you're here to tell me about it.
flirty.dialogue_event.mca.social.story.n: Lava and ghasts? That's a date I can happily do without.
flirty.dialogue.main/2: Hey there, sugar! How's your day going?
flirty.dialogue.main/3: Hey, good-looking! Nice to lay my eyes on you!
flirty.dialogue.main/5: How's the loveliest person I've seen today?
flirty.dialogue.main/6: Hey, %1$s! Got any juicy gossip for me, cutie?
flirty.dialogue.main/7: I ran into %supporter% and they told me about a zombie attack. I tried to listen, but I was distracted by how good they looked.
flirty.dialogue.rumors.failed/1: Oh, sweetie, I haven't come across any juicy gossip lately.
flirty.dialogue.rumors.lore/1: Jax still has followers, but more people are worshipping Sirben lately. MerlinWolfGames and Crow keep spreading his word.
flirty.dialogue.rumors.lore/2: Have you heard about the Ancient Builder disappearing? They say 2DA50 went to the Far Lands afterward and never came back.
flirty.dialogue.rumors.lore/3: Rumor says 2DA50 was involved when the Ancient Builder vanished, then disappeared into the Far Lands. Quite the mystery.
flirty.dialogue.rumors.lore/4: Prepare to be enchanted by this tale, my sweet. The illustrious MerlinWolfGames, with his awe-inspiring skills, has crafted a temple devoted solely to Sirben. It's simply breathtaking, one of the wonders of our time. A testament to the power of devotion and, dare I say, seduction.
flirty.dialogue.rumors.lore/5: There was once a whole race of builders. They've vanished now. Makes you wonder, doesn't it?
flirty.dialogue.rumors.lore/6: Ever heard the legends of the ancient builders? They left ruins and temples all over the Overworld.
flirty.dialogue.first.generic/1: Well, well, well, who do we have here? A fresh face in our humble village! Welcome, traveler, I must say, you've caught my eye.
flirty.dialogue.first.generic/2: A new face! And a rather lovely one, too. Care for a tour of the village?
flirty.dialogue.first.generic/3: Well, well, what do we have here? A charming stranger gracing our village with their presence! Consider me intrigued, darling.
flirty.dialogue.first.generic/4: Welcome, darling! I'm curious. What brings you to our village?
flirty.dialogue.first.generic/5: Well, look who wandered into town. Hello, traveler! You've caught my eye.
flirty.dialogue.first.generic/6: Hello there! You picked a lovely day to visit our little village.
flirty.dialogue.first.question/1: Well, hello there, handsome. What brings you to our village?
flirty.dialogue.first.question/2: A new face! How delightful. What brings you here?
flirty.dialogue.first.question/3: A charming adventurer! What brings you our way?
flirty.dialogue.first.exploring/1: We don't have much treasure here, but you're welcome to explore. Be gentle with my heart, though.
flirty.dialogue.first.exploring/2: Follow the village rules, handsome, and you're welcome to stay awhile.
flirty.dialogue.first.exploring/3: Mind your manners, traveler. A charming smile only gets you so far.
flirty.dialogue.first.settling/1: Well, aren't you a lovely surprise? Welcome to the village!
flirty.dialogue.first.settling/2: Welcome, neighbor! I have a feeling we'll get along wonderfully.
flirty.dialogue.first.settling/3: It's lovely to have another helping hand around here, especially yours.
flirty.dialogue.first.settling/4: So you're staying? Wonderful! I hope we'll see plenty of each other.
flirty.dialogue.first.spent_night.succes: If you need somewhere to stay, I recommend our inn, darling.
Our inn's a lovely place to rest after a long journey.
Looking for a bed and a good meal? Try our inn, sweetheart.
flirty.dialogue.first.spent_night.failed: Sorry, darling. We don't have an inn. Nobody here knows how to build one yet.
I'm afraid there's no inn here, sweetheart. Sorry about that.
Maybe another village has an inn. I'd hate for you to sleep outside.
flirty.dialogue.hug.success/1: Look who finally showed up! Come here, you.
flirty.dialogue.hug.success/2: Mm, I needed that hug. Thank you, darling.
flirty.dialogue.hug.success/3: Well, you've made my day a little brighter with that hug.
flirty.dialogue.hug.success/4: You're so soft! I could get used to this.
flirty.dialogue.hug.success/5: Oh, thank you, sweetheart. *Hugs you back*
flirty.dialogue.hug.success/6: You're warm as a furnace. I don't want to let go!
flirty.dialogue.hug.fail/1: Oh, you're filthy! Perhaps a hug after you've washed up?
flirty.dialogue.hug.fail/2: Not now, sweetheart. You can't charm me into a hug every time.
flirty.dialogue.hug.fail/3: A hug? Hmm, you'll have to ask again later.
flirty.dialogue.hug.fail/4: After teasing me like that last week? I don't think so, darling.
flirty.dialogue.hug.fail/5: You were rather unkind earlier. I'm not feeling affectionate right now.
flirty.dialogue.hug.fail/6: Sorry, love, but I'd rather not catch whatever germs you're carrying.
flirty.dialogue.hug.fail/7: Well, thank you for asking, but I don't feel like hugging right now.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.success/1: Oh, if only time could freeze in this blissful moment.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.success/2: Darling, my heart flutters just being near you... I may be falling for you.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.success/3: Mm, your lips taste like pumpkin pie.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.success/4: Mm, you taste like honey, darling.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.success/5: Oh, %1$s! You really know how to kiss.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.fail/1: Let's find a more secluded spot, darling.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.fail/2: Oh, honey, that's not the kind of kiss that will make me weak in the knees.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.fail/3: Sweetie, I've had more electrifying kisses from a sparkler.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.fail/4: Darling, I could use a hint of minty freshness after that smooch.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.fail/5: Well, aren't you just a charmer! Thank you, I guess?
flirty.dialogue.kiss.fail/6: Hands off, big shot! You need to up your game if you want a piece of this.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/1: Cookies and milk would be lovely right now. Care to join me?
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/2: Lovely weather today, isn't it? Makes me want to take a walk with you.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/3: I'm well, sweetheart, apart from stubbing my toe first thing this morning.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/4: An apple a day keeps the zombies away. Wonder if it works on a broken heart?
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/5: I'd love to build my own village someday. If only I weren't so lazy!
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/6: I think I saw %Supporter% wearing diamond armor the other day. Quite a look!
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/7: My friend %Supporter% found a chest full of diamonds yesterday. Imagine that!
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/8: I've been loving the sunny weather lately. Makes everything look brighter.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/9: I've lived here all my life. I still don't get why everyone's afraid of spiders and goblins.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/10: I wonder what happened to %Supporter%. They set out a whole year ago, you know.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/12: Have you heard what happened to %Supporter% the other day? I do love a little gossip.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/13: I'd love to adopt one of those stray cats, but I've been terribly busy lately.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/14: I've been thinking of redecorating my house. If only I could make myself get started.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/15: I'd love to have children someday. I just need to meet the right person.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/16: I wonder what my life would be like if I'd moved to the other village instead.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/17: I miss being a child sometimes. So many lovely memories.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/18: I haven't seen my parents in a while. Maybe I ought to visit them.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/19: I really should visit the next village. I've got friends there I haven't seen in ages.
flirty.dialogue.chat.success/20: I keep dreaming about something called cheese. Have you tried it, darling?
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/1: Oh, darling. You really said that out loud?
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/2: Darling, an explosion doesn't just happen all by itself. Try another story.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/3: You're cute, but that doesn't make what you said impressive.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/4: Showing off, are we? You'll need to try harder to impress me.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/5: Oh, sweetheart, that kind of talk could get you thrown in a dungeon.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/6: That outfit's a little old-fashioned, love. Not quite my style.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/7: Surely you've got something more interesting to talk about?
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/8: You're talking to me again? You really do like testing my patience.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/9: Sorry, darling. I wasn't listening. Did you have something worth saying?
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/10: Sorry, sweetheart, I'm not in the mood for that conversation.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/11: Of all the things to talk about, you chose that?
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/12: I've heard things about you. You're not making it easy to ignore them.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/13: Even a zombie would walk away from that conversation.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/14: Sweetie, you're being less charming than a witch right now.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/15: If you keep talking like that, I'll call the guards. Yes, even with that smile.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/16: Sorry, you lost me. I stopped listening halfway through.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/17: Are you finished? Because that wasn't your best work.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/18: Careful, darling. Keep talking like that and nobody will want to hear you.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/19: I'd rather stare at a pig's backside than listen to that again.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/20: Are you finished? I'd rather change the subject.
flirty.dialogue.chat.fail/21: You think the world is round? Really? Then where did all the corners go?
flirty.dialogue.story.success/1: All that really happened? What an adventure!
flirty.dialogue.story.success/2: If only I had the courage to face a creeper head-on, just like you do. You're so bold and daring!
flirty.dialogue.story.success/3: What a lovely story! Did you come up with it yourself?
flirty.dialogue.story.success/4: All of that happened yesterday? Oh, you must tell me more!
flirty.dialogue.story.success/5: I was near there yesterday. How did I miss all that?
flirty.dialogue.story.success/6: Haha! It's no surprise that %Supporter% is the star of such an awe-inspiring story. They're simply extraordinary!
flirty.dialogue.story.success/7: The legend of %Supporter%! I've heard it so many times. Tell me again, darling.
flirty.dialogue.story.success/8: So that's how you found your first diamond? How exciting!
flirty.dialogue.story.success/9: You must come visit me later! I would be absolutely delighted to hear more of your captivating tales.
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/1: *Ahem* Well, aren't you just a charmer? That's my mother you're talking about.
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/2: The village has been talking about you, and not in a good way.
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/3: I don't get it. Is there a point to that story?
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/4: That was awful! Even creepers deserve a little kindness.
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/5: How could you kill a poor sheep? You're breaking more than just my heart, you know.
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/6: *snoring* Huh? Oh! Sorry, love. Were you still telling that story?
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/7: Darling, that really wasn't worth my time.
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/9: Sweetheart, that sounded a little unhinged, and not in a good way.
flirty.dialogue.story.fail/10: I can't say that was a good story, darling.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.success/2: Oh, you smooth-talker! Your charm is off the charts!
flirty.dialogue.flirt.success/3: *Giggles* Are you trying to make my heart skip a beat?
flirty.dialogue.flirt.success/4: Oh my goodness, you're just too good-looking for words!
flirty.dialogue.flirt.success/5: That was beyond charming! You had me hooked from the moment I laid eyes on you!
flirty.dialogue.flirt.success/6: How do you always look so good? You've quite taken my breath away.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.success/7: Oh please, you're making me weak in the knees with those compliments!
flirty.dialogue.flirt.fail/1: If you're serious, then show me some real charm.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.fail/2: Oh honey, don't give me that line. I've heard it all before.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.fail/3: Darling, that's not gonna happen. Ever.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.fail/4: Seriously? You think that's gonna work on me? Try harder.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.fail/5: Sweetie, even a creeper has more game than you do.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.fail/6: Sorry, but that's a hard pass from me.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.fail/7: Oh darling, that look won't get you anywhere. And please, spare me from hearing that again.
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.success/3: Oh my, that's the most delightful joke I've heard all day!
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.success/5: Hahaha! You're such a charmer! You should consider a career in comedy, my dear!
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.success/6: Ha! Now that was a good one, darling!
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.success/7: Teehee! You're definitely more entertaining than Ash, my sweet!
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.success/8: Ahah! I must admit, that's actually pretty hilarious, darling!
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/1: Oh, sweetie, joking about that is a no-no.
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/2: Haha, nice try. But you'll have to do better to impress me.
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/3: You're cute, but your jokes need some work.
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/4: Ooh, did you really think that joke would make me laugh?
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/5: Well, bless your heart, that joke didn't quite hit the mark, did it?
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/6: Oh darling, you have quite the sense of humor... or lack thereof.
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/7: Honey, stick to your day job, because comedy clearly isn't your strong suit.
flirty.dialogue.joke.creative.failed/8: Ash tells better jokes, sweetheart. Perhaps you should take notes.
flirty.dialogue.procreate_engaged/1: I'd rather wait until we're married before we have a child, sweetheart.
flirty.dialogue.procreate_engaged/2: Having a child is a big step. I want us to be married first.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.success/1: Oh, you've got quite the firm handshake.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.success/2: Such a strong grip! You might sweep me off my feet.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.success/3: Why, aren't you polite? A lovely handshake.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.success/4: Good day, darling! Lovely to see you.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.success/5: Hello, handsome! It's good to hold your hand.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.fail/1: After what you did to that cow, darling? I don't think I can shake your hand.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.fail/2: No thank you, sweetheart. I'm not in the mood for a handshake.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.fail/3: We're hardly strangers, darling. You don't need to be so formal.
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.fail/4: A handshake from you? That's a surprise!
flirty.dialogue.shake_hand.fail/5: Sorry, darling. I don't feel like shaking hands right now.
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/2: Mornin', love. Are you ready to conquer the day together?
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/3: I'm still a little tired, but seeing you makes it all worth it.
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/5: You look like you had a rough night, darling. Everything all right?
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/6: Rise and shine, my darling. We've got a marathon of a day ahead.
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/7: Did you sleep well? You're looking rather lovely this morning.
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/8: Morning, sleepyhead! Want a little pick-me-up from yours truly?
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/9: What a beautiful morning! I'd love to spend some of it with you.
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/10: I might take it easy today, darling. I'm not feeling my best.
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/11: So much to do today. Maybe seeing you will make it go faster.
flirty.dialogue.main.morning/12: Slept surprisingly well. Perhaps I'll be up for something adventurous today.
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/2: Evening already? The day flew by. How was yours, darling?
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/3: Long day of work, wasn't it? You still look good, though.
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/4: So much to do, so little daylight. At least there's time to see you.
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/5: I'm off to make dinner. Would you care to join me later?
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/6: I wasted most of today. Would've been more fun spending it with you.
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/7: I'm exhausted. Might take a nap. You don't mind if I dream about you, do you?
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/8: I think I'll go inside soon. Saw a creeper last month, and I don't care to meet another one after dark.
flirty.dialogue.main.evening/9: Just picking up dinner supplies from the butcher. See you later, cutie!
flirty.dialogue.main.night/1: *yawn* So, what brings you out at this ungodly hour?
flirty.dialogue.main.night/2: A night owl, are you? I rather like that.
flirty.dialogue.main.night/3: You prefer the night, too? It's nice and quiet for a little flirting.
flirty.dialogue.main.night/4: Don't wander too far after dark, handsome. Monsters are out there.
flirty.dialogue.main.night/5: The guards keep us safe, but the village still feels eerie at night. Stay close, will you?
flirty.dialogue.main.night/6: Everything's so quiet after dark. Makes it easier to enjoy your company.
flirty.dialogue.main.night/7: I love a walk under the stars. Care to join me?
flirty.dialogue.main.night/8: I'm getting tired after today. Might take it easy tomorrow, darling.
flirty.dialogue.main.night/9: Can't wait to curl up under the covers. A little company would be nice.
flirty.dialogue.main.night/10: You ought to get some sleep, darling. You've got a busy day tomorrow.
flirty.dialogue.greet.mayor/2: Wishing you a fabulous day, my charming Mayor!
flirty.dialogue.greet.monarch/1: Your Highness, what a pleasure to see you.
flirty.dialogue.greet.monarch/2: Your Majesty! You've quite made my day.
flirty.dialogue.busy/1: We've had a lovely chat, but I've got work to get back to.
flirty.dialogue.busy/2: I'd much rather keep talking to you, but I've got work to finish tonight.
flirty.dialogue.busy/3: I'm a little busy, sweetheart. Can we talk later?
flirty.dialogue.busy/4: Sorry, darling, I've got to finish my work. Catch you later?
flirty.dialogue.busy/5: Oh no, I left my furnace burning! Save that charming story for later.
flirty.dialogue.goaway/2: Darling, don't you have more exciting things to occupy your time with?
flirty.dialogue.goaway/3: Oh, %1$s, I'm terribly sorry, but I simply can't chat at the moment.
flirty.dialogue.goaway/4: Oh, why don't you go annoy someone else, my dear?
flirty.dialogue.goaway/5: Away with you, you scandalous creature!
flirty.dialogue.greet/1: Hey, handsome! How are you doing today?
flirty.dialogue.greet/2: Well, hello, %1$s! How's the world treating you?
flirty.dialogue.greet/3: Oh, hello, stranger. Is there something I can do for you?
flirty.dialogue.greet/4: Well, well, well! Look at you, all dressed up and ready to conquer the world! How's it going?
flirty.dialogue.greet/5: %1$s! There you are. Always a pleasure to see you.
flirty.dialogue.greet/7: Ah, it's a delight to see your face!
flirty.dialogue.greet/8: Hello, darling! How are you today? It's lovely to see you.
flirty.dialogue.greet/9: Hey, you! Lovely to see you back.
flirty.dialogue.greet.negative/1: Oh, it's you. I was hoping for someone whose company I'd enjoy.
flirty.dialogue.greet.negative/2: Back again? I'd almost think you enjoyed annoying me.
flirty.dialogue.greet.negative/3: Well, there's an interruption I wasn't hoping for.
flirty.dialogue.greet.negative/4: Oh, it's you. I was expecting someone a little more pleasant.
flirty.dialogue.greet.negative/5: Look who's come to play their little game of annoyance again. You really can't resist, can you, my charming tormentor?
flirty.dialogue.greet.success/1: Oh, how lovely! I'm glad to hear it.
flirty.dialogue.greet.success/2: You're doing well? That's wonderful, sweetheart.
flirty.dialogue.greet.success/3: I'm delighted to hear that, darling!
flirty.dialogue.greet.success/4: That's excellent news! You deserve it.
flirty.dialogue.greet.success/5: Well, isn't that good news? I'm happy for you.
flirty.dialogue.greet.fail/1: Oh. Well, that wasn't quite the answer I hoped for.
flirty.dialogue.greet.fail/2: I see. Can't say I'm thrilled to hear that.
flirty.dialogue.greet.fail/3: Hmm. That certainly gives me something to think about.
flirty.dialogue.greet.fail/4: Oh, is that so? Well, that's a shame.
flirty.dialogue.greet.fail/5: Oh dear. I hardly know what to say to that.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.success/1: Oh honey, don't worry, mistakes happen to the best of us.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.success/2: Well, darling, it's alright. Just make sure to keep your eyes on me next time.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.success/3: Oh, I suppose that's acceptable, my dear. But do be cautious, won't you?
flirty.dialogue.apologize.success/4: No need to fret, my sweet. Everyone stumbles every now and then.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.success/5: Ah, my love, it's completely fine. I forgive you with all my heart.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.fail/1: Sweetheart, I think you should give me a little space.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.fail/2: Ouch! If you wanted my attention, hitting me was a terrible way to get it.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.fail/3: Don't think a sweet smile will make me forget you hit me.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.fail/4: Ow! That hurt. I'm not ready to forgive you just yet.
flirty.dialogue.apologize.fail/5: Darling, I know a fake apology when I hear one.
flirty.dialogue.location.failed/1: Hmm, no sweetie, I haven't caught wind of anything exciting lately.
flirty.dialogue.location.failed/2: Oh, darling, I wish I could be of more help, but there's no enchanting spots that have caught my attention.
flirty.dialogue.location.failed/3: Oh, honey, I don't believe so. Apologies, but us villagers have more enticing activities than rummaging through perilous dungeons like you brave explorers.
flirty.dialogue.location.forgot/1: Oh, I stumbled upon the most fascinating spot earlier, but alas, my memory failed me and I neglected to pinpoint it on my map. My apologies, my dear.
flirty.dialogue.location.forgot/2: Seeking a thrilling adventure, are we? Ah, I do recall... no, wait! It's slipping away! Blast! I had it right there, right on the edge of my consciousness! Apologies, my enchanting friend, I completely forgot to jot it down.
flirty.dialogue.location.forgot/3: Oh, my apologies, my captivating companion! There was indeed a remarkable location that crossed my path, but alas, it slipped through the sieve of my memory. I am deeply sorry for my forgetfulness.
flirty.dialogue.location.igloo/1: Oh, oh, guess what I stumbled upon at %2$s? An enchanting igloo! Can you imagine, a house made of snow? *giggles* It's simply too cold for my taste, darling.
flirty.dialogue.location.igloo/2: Darling, you won't believe what I discovered at %2$s! A deserted igloo, just waiting for someone adventurous like me to swoop in. But shh, between you and me, rumor has it that the place is bewitched. I swear, I get the most delightful shivers whenever I pass by...
flirty.dialogue.location.igloo/3: Oh, my dear, you won't believe what I found at %2$s. An abandoned ice sanctuary, they call it an igloo! Can you even fathom? It seems like no soul has graced its icy floors in ages. Such a tragic tale of forsaken beauty, don't you think?
flirty.dialogue.location.pyramid/1: Oh darling, have you seen that stunning pyramid over at %2$s? It's positively enchanting.
flirty.dialogue.location.pyramid/2: Rumor has it, my sweet, that there's a tantalizing pyramid waiting for you at %2$s. Perhaps it's destiny's way of bringing us together.
flirty.dialogue.location.pyramid/3: Listen, handsome, if you're feeling adventurous, head over to %2$s. I've heard whispers of a mysterious pyramid. Just a word of caution, don't let its charm distract you from the dangers that lie within.
flirty.dialogue.location.ruined_portal_d: Oh, darling, you won't believe what I've stumbled upon in the scorching desert - a completely wrecked portal at %2$s!
flirty.dialogue.location.ruined_portal_s: Hey gorgeous, listen up! There's this seriously wrecked portal at %2$s, surrounded by the swamp. I bet those Nether invaders were expecting something grand, but instead they ended up in this total dump. Talk about a major disappointment!
flirty.dialogue.location.ruined_portal/1: Oh honey, let me tell you something scandalous. There's this totally destroyed portal over at %2$s. It's like the aftermath of a wild Nether invasion. Hot, right?
flirty.dialogue.location.ruined_portal/2: Babes, listen up. If you dare to venture towards %2$s, you'll stumble upon the most tantalizingly ruined nether portal. It's got this spine-chilling aura, but hey, safety first! Just make sure to avoid the magma, darling.
flirty.dialogue.location.ruined_portal/3: Sweetie, I've got some juicy gossip for you. If you ever find yourself in %2$s, you'll come across these ancient ruins. Rumor has it, it used to be a glamorous nether portal. Some cheeky folks even claim there might be treasure hidden there, but honestly, nobody wants to go anywhere near that place. It's like a forbidden love affair.
flirty.dialogue.location.ruined_portal_m: Oh my, you won't believe what I've discovered! There's this captivatingly destroyed portal in the mountains at %2$s. It's like a tragic love story waiting to be rewritten. Care to join me, my charming companion?
flirty.dialogue.location.mansion/1: Oh honey, if you're feeling adventurous, you simply must visit %2$s. There's this enchanting mansion owned by those illagers. But be warned, darling, it's positively cursed!
flirty.dialogue.location.mansion/2: Listen, sweet cheeks, there's a massive mansion over at %2$s that belongs to those illagers. Now, I'm not one to gossip, but I've heard whispers that maybe, just maybe, it's high time we pack our bags and relocate this village. Far, far away from that place, if you catch my drift...
flirty.dialogue.location.monument/1: Oh, darling, there's this breathtaking sunken castle, guarded by the most enchanting sea monsters, at %2$s. But, my dear, be cautious and avoid it at all costs.
flirty.dialogue.location.monument/2: Sweetheart, let me tell you about the whispers of an ancient underwater treasure trove, nestled deep in the ocean at %2$s. It's a daring adventure, my love, but oh, the treasures you could discover. Just remember, danger lurks at every turn.
flirty.dialogue.location.shipwreck/1: Oh, darling, you won't believe what I discovered beneath the waves! There's a mesmerizing sunken ship at %2$s, once the pride of the Eastern Alliance Company.
flirty.dialogue.location.shipwreck/2: My dear, rumor has it that a group of dashing fishermen uncovered a shipwreck at %2$s. Just imagine the secrets and treasures waiting to be discovered within its depths... Don't you find it utterly thrilling?
flirty.dialogue.location.shipwreck_beach: Oh darling, do I have news for you! I stumbled upon a breathtakingly ruined ship at %2$s, right there on the beach. It's an absolute spectacle, and you simply can't afford to miss it!

Picture this, my sweet adventurer. Venture towards %2$s, and oh, what do you find? A ship, lost and abandoned, stranded on the shore. The mysteries behind its tragic fate, my love, are simply tantalizing to ponder.
flirty.dialogue.location.village_desert/: Oh, my dearest, you won't believe your eyes when you stumble upon the mesmerizing village located at %2$s, amidst the unforgiving desert's embrace.
flirty.dialogue.location.village_taiga/1: Oh, darling, you simply must visit %2$s! There's another charming village nestled right in the heart of the enchanting taiga biome.
flirty.dialogue.location.village_taiga/2: If you're feeling adventurous, my dear, head on over to %2$s and prepare to be captivated. Trust me, you won't be disappointed. It's tucked away in the luscious taiga biome, a hidden gem waiting to be discovered by someone as alluring as you.
flirty.dialogue.location.village_snowy/1: Hey there, sugar! Just a hop, skip, and a jump away, you'll find another village. Oh, baby, let me warn you, it's absolutely freezing over there!
flirty.dialogue.location.village_snowy/2: Oh, darling, let me tell you a little secret. Nestled in the snowy plains, there's another village at %2$s. The people? Oh, they're as sweet as can be, but be prepared, my love, it's colder than an ice queen's heart over there!
flirty.dialogue.location.village_plains/: Oh, darling, let me tell you about the charming village that awaits you at %2$s.
My sweet, venture deep into the plains and discover the hidden gem of a village at %2$s.
flirty.dialogue.location.village_savanna: Oh honey, you won't believe it! Just a little way from here, there's another village tucked away in the scorching hot savanna. It's like stepping into a steamy oasis!
Darling, if you ever find yourself in the savanna at %2$s, you simply must visit the other village nearby. Trust me, the people there are not only nice, but they also ooze with irresistible charm.
flirty.dialogue.location.swamp_hut/1: Oh honey, let me tell you about that sultry swamp over yonder at %2$s. There's this bewitching enchantress who calls it her home. If I were you, I'd steer clear of that place, unless you want to get caught in her web of trouble.
flirty.dialogue.location.swamp_hut/2: Listen up, darling. %2$s is not your average swamp. It's got this mysterious hut where a wickedly alluring witch resides. Trust me, you don't want to find yourself anywhere near that place. The only thing she'll cast on you is trouble, and you won't be able to resist her spellbinding charm.
flirty.dialogue.location.mineshaft/1: Hey there, gorgeous. You know, we had a mine here, but unfortunately, it got shut down after this juicy little incident. You might find it at %2$s if you're curious.
flirty.dialogue.location.mineshaft/2: Oh, sweet thing, listen up. We used to own this fabulous mine, right at %2$s. But, darling, it's now infested with all sorts of creepy crawlies. So, if you're brave enough to venture down there, just be careful, my lovely.
flirty.dialogue.location.jungle_pyramid/: Oh, darling, there's this mesmerizing temple at %2$s. It's positively thrilling! But, I must warn you, it's not for the faint of heart. Those cunning traps could easily make anyone swoon!

In the enchanting jungle nearby, my dear, you'll stumble upon ancient ruins at %2$s. Do you dare to explore? Oh, but be careful, for those ancient traps are still as alluring as ever! Our ancestors couldn't resist its charms, and neither should you.
flirty.dialogue.location.pillager_outpos: Hold onto your heart, honey! There's this tantalizing outpost owned by those seductive pillagers at %2$s. Let me warn you, they won't just steal your sleep at night, they'll steal your heart too. If you dare to venture near, be cautious because they shoot on sight, but who knows, maybe you'll find yourself falling head over heels for one of them.

Oh, honey, have you heard about that irresistible pillager outpost at %2$s? Those naughty bandits keep us up all night. If you dare to get close, darling, watch out! They'll aim their arrows straight at your heart.

Well, well, well... If you're feeling a bit adventurous, my dear, I must tell you that %2$s is home to an outpost owned by those devilishly attractive pillagers. Oh, the thrill of it all! If you're brave enough to face those wicked villains, who knows what treasures you might discover. And let me tell you, the entire village would be eternally grateful if someone as charming as you took care of those rogues.
flirty.dialogue.location.ancient_city/0: Oh, darling, have you heard those mysterious and alluring sounds echoing from %2$s? Deep beneath the surface, a secret awaits.
flirty.dialogue.location.ancient_city/1: Oh, my curious heart, I have this undeniable feeling that there's something enchanting hidden far beneath the ground at %2$s. Care to join me on an adventure of discovery?
flirty.dialogue.location.ancient_city/3: Ah, my dear, let me share with you the whispers of legends. It is said that %2$s houses an ancient city, shrouded in mystery. Alas, I have yet to lay my eyes upon its underground wonders. Care to embark on a quest for its hidden treasures with me?
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.success/1: Haha! That Skelly never stood a chance against you, darling!
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.success/2: That zombie came at you with a shovel? Oh, darling, that's hilarious!
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.success/3: You certainly showed that spider who's boss!
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.success/4: A skeleton killed a creeper for you? That's impressive!
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.success/5: Hah! Those cave spiders really aren't very clever, are they?
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/1: Oh, sweetheart, leave the skeletons alone! They're people too... sort of.
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/2: Creeper explosion jokes? Darling, that's a little old by now.
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/3: Those zombies and skeletons were people once, you know. That's hardly something to joke about.
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/4: An enderman fell in water? Oh, how original. *Yawn*
flirty.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/5: If I had a nickel for every silverfish-on-the-toilet joke, I'd have two nickels. Strange, isn't it?
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.success/1: The poor sheep lost all its wool! I know I shouldn't laugh, but...
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.success/2: And then the wolf fell in love with the sheep! Oh, that's adorable.
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.success/3: That chicken joke! I can't believe they could do that!
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.success/4: Oh honey, that's just too silly for words, but you know what? I adore it! It's the kind of humor that makes my heart skip a beat!
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.success/5: Good thing cows never seem to run out of milk, darling!
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/1: Oh, darling, you shouldn't jest about such matters.
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/2: Oh, that poor sheep! That's not funny, darling.
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/3: Hey, that's my pig you're joking about!
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/4: That's just so beneath you, my love.
flirty.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/5: Leave my cow's eyebrows alone, sweetheart!
flirty.dialogue.flirt.slap/1: Excuse me! Being charming doesn't mean you can say things like that.
flirty.dialogue.flirt.slap/2: What on earth was that? Did an enderman teach you to flirt?
flirty.dialogue.kiss.slap/1: How dare you! I was being friendly, not inviting that.
flirty.dialogue.kiss.slap/2: Try that again without asking and you'll get another slap.
flirty.dialogue.story.exploring.success/: Howdy! I reckon I'll embark on my own worldly adventure someday, darling!
Your adventures sound wonderful. I love my family and village, but they make me want to see more of the world.
You're brave to go exploring on your own. I rather admire that, darling.
flirty.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/1: Darling, your tales are becoming dreadfully predictable.
flirty.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/2: Oh my, don't hurt yourself with all that sass, darling.
flirty.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/3: Talking to you is like listening to a child brag about what they'll do when they grow up. Less charming, though.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.success/1: Is the Nether really that hot, darling?
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.success/2: You survived the Nether? Now that's impressive, sweetheart.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.success/3: I hear there's treasure in the Nether. I'd need someone brave to go with me.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.success/4: Aren't you frightened when you go to the Nether? I know I would be.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.success/5: Have you ever seen a zombified piglin, darling?
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.fail/1: Oh darling, I don't believe you've ever set foot in the Nether.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.fail/2: No wonder those Piglins attacked you. You didn't sound prepared at all.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.fail/3: I'm sure the Nether is fascinating, sweetheart, but that story wasn't.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.fail/4: You don't look strong enough to survive in the Nether, darling.
flirty.dialogue.story.nether.fail/5: My grandpa explored the Nether, and he never mentioned warped fungus. Are you making this up?
flirty.dialogue.story.enderdragon.succes: Oh my, have you come bearing not only the spoils of victory but also the majestic dragon egg? How utterly captivating!
You defeated the Ender Dragon? The whole village will be talking about you for years, darling!
flirty.dialogue.story.enderdragon.fail/1: Oh my, sweetie, have you lost your marbles? The ender dragon is nothing but a fantastical tale.
flirty.dialogue.story.enderdragon.fail/2: Oh darling, you can't be serious! No mortal soul could even dream of laying a finger on that majestic dragon!
flirty.dialogue.story.wither.success/1: You fought the Wither? I heard it can destroy nearly anything!
flirty.dialogue.story.wither.success/2: You actually defeated the Wither? Oh, you're full of surprises, darling!
flirty.dialogue.story.wither.fail/1: Oh, darling, I don't believe a word of that Wither story.
flirty.dialogue.story.wither.fail/2: You look far too unhurt to have fought the Wither, sweetheart.
flirty.dialogue.stay.fail/1: No way, darling! I'm all about the thrill of adventure.
flirty.dialogue.stay.fail/2: It's sweet of you to ask, but I still want to travel the world.
flirty.dialogue.stay.fail/3: Your village is lovely, but I'd rather be out exploring, darling.
flirty.dialogue.stay.repeat/1: Darling, you've already inquired about that.
flirty.dialogue.stay.repeat/2: Oh honey, you've already posed that question to me.
flirty.dialogue.stay.success/1: Oh, thank you! I would absolutely adore staying in this charming village!
flirty.dialogue.stay.success/2: Oh my, this village is simply marvelous! I would be delighted to stay here!
flirty.dialogue.stay.no_space/1: I'd consider staying, but the village is already so full.
flirty.dialogue.stay.no_space/2: I'd love to stay, sweetheart, but there aren't any spare beds.
flirty.dialogue.hire/1: Of course, sweetheart. Call me when you need help, and don't forget the emeralds.
flirty.dialogue.hire/2: Just say the word when you need me. My work comes at a price, darling.
flirty.dialogue.hire/3: You can hire me, darling. Just have the emeralds ready when it's time to work.
flirty.dialogue.no_money/1: Darling, you don't have enough emeralds to hire me. Come back when you've got more.
flirty.dialogue.no_money/2: I appreciate the offer, but I'll need more emeralds before I can work for you.
flirty.dialogue.no_money/3: Sorry, love. My work costs more than that. Bring a few more emeralds.
flirty.dialogue.main.rock_paper_scissor/: Wanna play a little game of Rock Paper Scissors, honey?
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor/1: Rock, paper, scissors, shoot! Ready, darling?
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor/2: Think you can beat me at rock, paper, scissors?
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.rock/: Rock! A solid choice, don't you think?
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.paper: Oh, baby, paper is our secret weapon! It glides through the air like a love note, sealing our triumph.
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.sciss: Ooh, look at these scissors! Sharp and ready to cut through anything, just like my charm!
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.loose: Oh, darling! I picked paper! Looks like I've outsmarted you!
I'll pick scissors, darling. Think you can beat me?
Rock beats scissors! Better luck next time, sweetheart.
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.win.r: Your rock crushed my scissors. I lost this one!
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.win.p: Your paper beats my rock. You've got me, darling.
flirty.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.win.s: Your scissors cut my paper. Well played, sweetheart.
